known.title: Follow-up: write the preservation fixture as bytes on Windows

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 1, Harm 1
Case: normal use - running the full test suite on Windows. `env.repo.write` calls `Path.write_text` without specifying newline handling (`tests/conftest.py:328-331`). Python therefore [translates LF to the platform line separator](https://docs.python.org/3.11/library/functions.html#open), producing CRLF bytes on Windows. The assertion at line 114 compares those bytes against the LF-only `original`, so this test fails even when upgrade preserves the file correctly. Create the fixture with `write_bytes(original)` so the preservation assertions compare against the bytes actually supplied.
